Internal helper: run an analysis function's body, printing or silent

Source: R/pipeline-internals.R
dot-jst_output_scope.Rd

Wraps the whole body of each analysis function (jdesc, jfreq, jt, jaov, jcrosstab, jlm, jlogistic, jcorr, jalpha, jscreen). When the call prints (.jst_print_on()), the body runs as it is. When it does not, its standard output goes to a null file (every table and title is written with cat(), and the stdout emitter's prose with it) and its messages are muffled (every note goes through message()), while warnings and errors pass: a warning is a condition the handler leaves alone, and an error unwinds through the sink's on.exit, so both show as they always have. The body's own return() calls, on.exit() calls, sys.call() and match.call() work as before: the body is a promise evaluated in the function's own frame. The value is the body's, visible or not as the body left it.

Usage

.jst_output_scope(print, body)

Arguments

print

The call's print argument, already checked.

body

The function's body, braced.

Value

The body's value.
